items.title: DeVonta Smith: Feeling 'good' about prospects
items.text:
Smith (hamstring) said Friday that he is "good" and that his availability for Week 6 is "up to the doctors," Tim McManus of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Will avoid injured reserve
items.text:
Monangai (toe), per head coach Ben Johnson, remains week-to-week but is "trending in the right direction" and will avoid injured reserve, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Will not play Sunday
items.text:
Love (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alvin Kamara: Listed as questionable
items.text:
Kamara (back) practiced on a limited basis Friday is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at the Giants, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: KC Concepcion: Out of concussion protocol
items.text:
Concepcion has cleared concussion protocol and will play Sunday against the Ravens, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
